definitions.gloss: anime adaptation; making something into an anime
definitions.explanation: The process of adapting a work (typically a manga, light novel, or game) into an anime series or film. A very common term in Japanese pop culture discussions.

examples.japanese: アニメ{化|か}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決定|けってい}した→決定する：21022_ketteisuru⟧。
examples.english: The anime adaptation has been confirmed.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{漫画|まんが}→漫画：01511_manga⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついにアニメ{化|か}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧らしい。
examples.english: Apparently that manga is finally getting an anime adaptation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦ライト→ライト：13631_raito⟧ノベル⟦の→の：09472_no⟧アニメ{化|か}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦ファン→ファン：10065_fan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{盛|も}り{上|あ}がっている→盛り上がる：06344_moriagaru⟧。
examples.english: The announcement of the popular light novel's anime adaptation has fans excited.

notes:
A compound of ⟦アニメ→アニメ：01527_anime⟧ (anime) + ⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧ (transformation/-ification). The suffix ⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧ is highly productive in Japanese, creating words meaning 'turning into X' or 'making into X.'

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- アニメ{化|か}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決定|けってい}する→決定する：21022_ketteisuru⟧: for an anime adaptation to be confirmed
- アニメ{化|か}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be adapted into anime
- アニメ{化|か}⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧: anime-adapted work
- アニメ{化|か}⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧: anime adaptation announcement

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{映画化|えいがか}→映画化：23773_eigaka⟧: film adaptation — adapting a work into a live-action or animated film
- ⟦{実写化|じっしゃか}→実写化：17313_jisshaka⟧: live-action adaptation — specifically adapting anime/manga into live-action
- ⟦ドラマ{化|か}→ドラマ化：26046_doramaka⟧: drama adaptation — adapting into a TV drama series
- {漫画化|まんがか}: manga adaptation — the reverse: adapting something into manga (less common)
